summary: The team is juggling urgent operational fixes (Outlook lockout) with strategic marketing pushes for Asia Star and Intelligent China, while the knowledge website redesign and brand video refinements are in progress.
summaryDetail: The most pressing issue is the Outlook lockout affecting the team, requiring immediate action to delete accounts on all devices and re-login, with JSB support for backend unlock. Strategically, the marketing team is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, launching the Intelligent China webpage this week (split into three pages with a hub) to drive traffic, and refining SEO targeting for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing. The knowledge website redesign is underway, with feedback due from Joseph and Julie to move toward a more editorial layout featuring BCI indices. Additionally, the brand video is being re-cut based on consolidated feedback, and preparations are underway for Dean Xiang's speaking engagement at Tech in Asia on Sept 15, including contract and marketing materials.
